does: Completes a character's combat AI calculation: logs 'Calculation complete', warns when a flying spell needs a navigation-cloud trigger, and removes the request from the AI's tables.

evidence.says: the two log strings and a hash-table Remove on the AI data
A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a fight was on, 30 times, once per finished enemy decision, from 1 place, UpdateCombatAiRequest

questions.ask: A probe at the end of an enemy's decision that reads the AI's request table before and after the call would show the request removed.
